new_policies.name: student-template-public-forks-v1-normal
new_policies.description: Bounded public quiet double threats with executable one-turn capture followthrough.
new_policies.model: Unchanged honest opening-template Flag/Bomb posterior and native ranked search. Quiet moves only: a public double threat against disclosed mobile victims must have a positive short material-conversion certificate strictly exceeding the native common control. Universal count-feasible enemy public replies, one disclosed surviving friendly capture, universal second enemy replies. Fixed root material worth includes collateral losses and Flag/immobility counterwins. A transient exact-public-successor witness executes the certified fork-actor capture next turn; immediate Flag wins take priority. All candidate and control proofs share a20000enemy-outcome cap; incomplete proofs fall back. One native search per turn, no extra RNG; actual selection repairs native history. Python research prototype, no CX16 cost qualification.
new_policies.information_model: Own army, public revealed ranks/movement/captures/counts and source-informed population prior only. Proof branches use count-feasible hidden support without consulting actual enemy identities. No opponent setup, referee truth, deployment seed or private RNG.

hypotheses: A bounded public double threat with an executable capture response converts games better than the same native opening-inference policy without that tactical plan.
analysis: Fresh fixed-sample exploratory single contrast with95%paired intervals and missing-error sensitivity. No tuning on these games and no promotion without fresh independent validation. Certifies bounded short material conversion, not game value or long-term Flag safety. Prototype has substantial eligible-root host overhead; not target ready. DOS and honest stress outcomes remain separate.
evidence: research/quiet-fork-runtime-v1;38combined mechanical/integration tests,900frozen oldscope decisions and300public-history adapter decisions. Root frozen portable qualification required before games. Original preflight fixture metadata correction explicitly preserved.
